name: gizza-ai/code-screenshot
summary: Render a code snippet into a syntax-highlighted PNG

tool.description: Render a code snippet into a shareable, syntax-highlighted PNG image (carbon-style window chrome on a padded background). Use this when the user wants a picture/screenshot/carbon image of code rather than the code as text. Returns an image, not text.

code.description: The source code to render. Required.

language.description: Language for syntax highlighting (e.g. "rust", "python", "javascript", "bash"). Optional — unknown or omitted falls back to plain text.

theme.description: Color theme name (e.g. "base16-ocean.dark", "Solarized (dark)", "InspiredGitHub"). Optional — defaults to a dark theme.
